slice: Slice 4 -- Library / SQLite Baseline Truth Recovery

diagnosis.root_cause: Backend server was started with wrong Python environment (venv/ instead of .venv/), which lacked aiosqlite. The lifecycle.py startup swallowed the ModuleNotFoundError, then route handlers crashed with unhandled ImportError manifesting as HTTP 500.
diagnosis.secondary_issue: GET /api/library/folders returned a raw JSON array, but the C# LibraryClient expects a wrapper object {folders: [...]} (LibraryFoldersResponse).

fixes: Added FoldersResponse Pydantic model wrapping the folders list
Changed GET /folders response_model from list[LibraryFolder] to FoldersResponse
Added sqlite3.OperationalError guard to GET /folders (was only on /assets)
Confirmed aiosqlite>=0.19.0 in requirements chain (root -> backend -r ../requirements.txt)
